source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U17: Identify bankers records and certification requirements for paper and electronic copies

payload.title: Prepare the evidence package, not just a printout
payload.core_explanation_md:
The1891 framework covers the described ordinary bank records, including electronic and backup records. A printout is not made a certified copy merely by adding a logo. Paper-copy certification addresses the true entry, ordinary business record and custody conditions; where the original was routinely destroyed, the further certification described in the source matters.

For electronic printouts, section2A adds the computer-system and integrity certifications: authorised access, change detection, recovery, transfer and custody safeguards, plus the required statement about material operation and derivation. Identify the competent signatories and retained record. This unit is expressly about the1891 syllabus framework; later replacement legislation and commencement need separate review.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an unsigned spreadsheet export itself satisfy the described certification framework?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable certificates and record conditions must be established.

payload.stem_md: An electronic account statement is produced without the required system/integrity certification. What must the evidence team address?

options.text_md: Only the font size of the statement
A declaration that all printouts are conclusive
options.explanation_md: A printout needs the applicable evidentiary foundation.
Preference does not supply the required certificate.

options.text_md: The prescribed certification and underlying system safeguards
options.explanation_md: The source distinguishes electronic integrity evidence from a bare export.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source distinguishes electronic integrity evidence from a bare export.

payload.stem_md: A paper original was destroyed in the ordinary course after a copy was made. Which aspect of the described framework needs attention?

options.text_md: The debt must automatically be written off
options.explanation_md: Record destruction does not itself extinguish a debt.

options.text_md: The further certification about the original record and copy conditions
options.explanation_md: The source addresses this evidentiary circumstance expressly.

options.text_md: A newly invented original should be created
options.explanation_md: Fabricating a record is not certification.

options.text_md: Every transaction becomes legally admitted by the customer
options.explanation_md: The customer admission cannot be assumed.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source addresses this evidentiary circumstance expressly.
